result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides, but pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic. A small concrete median provides some refuge, though parked vehicles near the crossing point create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: A white SUV is parked close to the crosswalk on the right, potentially blocking the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross at least four lanes of traffic, increasing the time spent in the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway and presence of parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with multi-lane traffic and standard pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk. However, the long crossing distance across four lanes of traffic without a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure and risk.
